title: Computer-Aided Pulmonary Fibrosis Detection Leveraging an Advanced Artificial Intelligence Triage and Notification Software.
summary: An AI triage/notification system detects pulmonary fibrosis patterns on chest imaging in clinical records.
ai_technology: The study evaluates the deployed software against radiologist-confirmed fibrosis findings and reports detection/notification performance.
organization: Section of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine

evidence.tested: An AI triage/notification system detects pulmonary fibrosis patterns on chest imaging in clinical records.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective triage evidence does not prove earlier treatment or improved outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: The study evaluates the deployed software against radiologist-confirmed fibrosis findings and reports detection/notification performance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
